assetSources.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL transparent RGBA game sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate full-body mounted messenger poses with very generous empty transparent gutters and safe exterior margins. Match the supplied reference's SAME rider and SAME chestnut horse: brown broad-brim hat, ochre shirt, dark teal waistcoat, tan trousers, brown boots, saddle and brown shoulder dispatch bag; chestnut horse black mane/tail and small white forehead marking. Rustic illustrated Texas 1835 miniature game art, earthy dark outlines and restrained shading. Fixed east-facing elevated side/three-quarter view in ALL 16 cells. Keep horse's four hooves planted, saddle and rider proportions and anchor constant across all frames. No walking or grazing. Animate upper-body gestures only; reins stay in the left hand. Row1 four frames: mounted listener, attentive neutral, small head tilt, small nod, return neutral. Row2 four frames: mounted speaking, right hand relaxed, right palm small open gesture, a gentle outward gesture, return near neutral. Row3 four frames: rider takes a folded cream letter from shoulder bag, draws it out, holds it toward someone on the ground on right, arm extended offering letter. Row4 four frames: mounted rider points along road east, first hand rises, points east, holds pointing, hand lowers. DO NOT include any second person, speech bubble, text, panel border, grass, floor or background. Each cell shows the complete horse and rider, no cropping, no overlap between cells. Real transparent alpha, NOT a checkerboard painted in the image. These will be cut into independent timed frames. Preserve reference identity closely and make sequence actions readable.
assetSources.alphaCorrectionPrompt: Fix the attached 16-pose mounted messenger sprite sheet. Preserve all 16 drawings and their 4 by 4 reading order, same identities, gestures and positions. REMOVE the entire gray and white checkerboard background, replacing it with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA pixels. The output must be a genuine 8-bit RGBA PNG with alpha=0 in all empty areas including gaps between legs, reins and figures. Do not paint a transparency pattern or flat color. Keep dark outlines, no white/checkered halo. Do not add or alter art. Leave generous transparent margins around each pose. This is a production sprite sheet, not a mockup of one.
assetSources.rejectionReason: Opaque RGB with painted checkerboard. Replaced using built-in image generation; no local pixel removal.
assetSources.postProcessing: None. Final built-in generated PNG copied unchanged; alpha measured only.
assetSources.review: Four E/W mounted actions: listening, speaking, letter offer, pointing. Horse/rider proportions need final cross-sheet registration; transitions and other facings remain production work.

rejectedAttempts: Landscape sheets with opaque brown backgrounds were replaced by genuinely transparent square generations.
An edit returned baked checkerboard pixels and was not shipped.
The first military-actions sheet clipped hands/weapons; a clean regeneration replaced it.
The later rounded Alamo facade remains only in its original source sheet; its cell is excluded from every usable frame and clip.

applicationIcon.origin: Supplied by the owner, 2026-09-11. Generated with ChatGPT and handed over as a PNG with a transparent field.
applicationIcon.postProcessing: Trimmed to the emblem, squared with transparent padding, and written as a multi-resolution .ico at 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 pixels. No recolouring and no redrawing.
applicationIcon.whereItAppears: The executable, and from there Explorer, the taskbar, the Start menu entry and the desktop shortcut, plus the title bar of every window the launcher opens.
applicationIcon.note: Decorative, and not a historical illustration. It is a general Texas emblem: the Alamo it shows is San Antonio in 1836, a different place and a later year than the Gonzales afternoon this prototype simulates. Nothing in the game reads it and it makes no historical claim.
